source.notes: Scanned school paper (no text layer apart from the icseboard.org watermark). Header printed: 'FIRST TERM EXAMINATION - 2022-2023', 'STANDARD - VIII', 'SUBJECT - MATHEMATICS', 'Time: 2½Hrs.', 'M.M:80'. examYear 2023 is the later year of the printed academic year (the file name date 220922 suggests the paper was sat in September 2022). No school name printed. SECTION - A (10 X 4 = 40): attempt all questions, Q.1-Q.4. SECTION - B (40 marks), introduced by a line numbered '5.': 'Attempt any four questions out of seven', with its questions numbered again from 1 to 7; to keep keys unique, Section B parts are stored as '(Section B) a)' etc. Listed marks therefore exceed 80. Pages 2 and 4 are skewed, so marks were matched to the nearest item (consistent with each question totalling 10). Section B Q.2 a) and Q.4 a) show no printed mark (marks 0, flagged). Pen ticks over question numbers and the WhatsApp/Paytm advert at the end of page 4 are ignored. No answer key.
source.usage: School examination paper published on icseboard.org (originally icseonline.com); question text reproduced for study with attribution and a link to where it was obtained. Figures are not reproduced.
